adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` whenever `safeParse` fails, and only returns a Zod result when `success === true`. Therefore in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the subsequent `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { return Promise.reject(...) }` is unreachable/dead code because `accessTokenParsed` cannot be a failed parse result—failure would have thrown earlier. This is a real, diff-grounded issue, but it’s not a functional defect (error handling still occurs via the throw); it’s redundant/misleading control flow.
